messages:
maria (PM): ok team, starting a short intake for a Response Quality Gate PRD. Problem: customers notice regressions after model upgrades (AcmePay reported a 7% hallucination spike). we need a fast way to block bad rollouts. please flag missing pieces.

kevin (ML): from call notes: AcmePay saw 7% user-visible hallucinations after a minor model update. they want automated checks both pre-rollout (simulated) and live (traffic-based) with clear rollback.

sara (Eng): are we gating per model version or per route? can be per-tenant?

maria (PM): primary scope: per-deployment-route (e.g. /payments, /support). per-tenant tuning is a stretch goal for later. non-goal: no retraining or model selection logic changes in v1.

jonah (SRE): non-functional reqs: any live-gate evaluation must not add >50ms p50 latency under normal traffic. if we need async checks, traffic must continue using previous model until gate closes. audit logs required.

eva (Customer Success): customers want two capabilities: 1) Pre-rollout validation against a holdout prompt set; 2) Live canary/monitoring that auto-rollback if quality drops. they also want human override and clear notifications. :+1:

kevin (ML): suggested signal set: hallucination_rate (binary classifier on responses), semantic_shift (embedding drift vs baseline), and task_success_rate (customer-defined golden examples). proposal for thresholds below.

maria (PM): draft acceptance criteria (open to edit):
```
- Pre-rollout gate: run holdout suite (n >= 500) in CI. New model passes when hallucination_rate <= baseline + 1.2% AND median_semantic_shift <= 0.08.
- Live gate: rolling 10m window; if hallucination_rate increases by >0.5% absolute OR task_success_rate drops by >2% absolute, set "gate_open" = false and trigger rollback.
- Performance: synchronous gate checks must not push p95 latency > 150ms; preferred design is async classification with fast path fallback.
- Observability: gate decision emits event with reason, metric deltas, and links to sample failures.
```

kevin (ML): note: classifiers have FPR/FNR tradeoffs. example operating points I9ll post tomorrow (want to balance false-positive rollbacks vs missed regressions).

sara (Eng): implementation sketch: reuse eval harness for pre-rollout. live checks: lightweight streaming classifier (CPU/GPU?) — likely a tiny GPU or batching CPU workers. controller keeps state per-route and exposes API + Console. will add infra cost estimate.

jonah (SRE): rollout policies to support: manual canary -> ramp -> full; auto-block on gate; manual override with audit trail. if controller fails, must default to safe behavior (continue previous stable model). document how auto-rollback affects open requests and retries.

eva (Customer Success): edge cases to capture: intermittent network errors creating apparent quality drops; locale drift where baselines are sparse; deterministic changes that alter embeddings but are acceptable to users. customers want per-customer thresholds and an opt-out.

maria (PM): success metrics for launch:
- adoption: >= 30% of rollouts use gate within 60 days of GA
- effectiveness: >= 60% reduction in post-rollout quality incidents for opt-ins
- operational burden: false-positive rollback rate <= 1% (measured during beta)

sara (Eng): QA checklist: unit tests for detector integration, load test to prove <50ms p50 overhead for live checks, chaos test where detector RPCs fail (must not block traffic), end-to-end test with rollout controller and rollback.

jonah (SRE): monitoring dashboard: gate_status_by_route, rollback_count, avg_detection_latency, sample_failure_rate, estimated_false_positive_rate. set alert if rollback_count > 1 in 1h for any route.

maria (PM): timeline: spec review this week, prototype in sprint 1-3, beta with 2-3 pilot customers in sprint 4-5. owners: maria (PM), sara (Eng), kevin (ML), jonah (SRE).

maria (PM): asks: @kevin share classifier ROC points by EOD tomorrow; @sara rough infra delta + ticket; @eva recruit 2 pilots (AcmePay is interested).

kevin (ML): will run evals and post ROC + sample classifier thresholds tomorrow.

sara (Eng): will add cost delta in spec and link infra ticket.

eva (Customer Success): will confirm AcmePay + BetaBank for pilot.

kanban-bot: Card created: "PRD: response-quality-gate (maria)" -> https://kanban/board/card/4567 :card_file_box:

maria (PM): thanks all. please add any missing acceptance criteria and edge cases inline. i9ll consolidate and post PRD link when ready. :sparkles:
